description: The ways bytes go out of the board and come in: a BLE characteristic, a UART port.

commands.label: Remove a provider
commands.description: Removes a provider no one uses (not the board's own).

returns.label: Number of providers
returns.description: Then per provider: its id u8, link u8 (sys_data_provider_link_e), state u8 (SYS_DATA_PROVIDER_STATE_*).

commands.label: Send on a provider
commands.description: Sends one frame on a provider, whoever reads from it. Do not use it on a provider a session runs on: the bytes land between its frames.

fields.label: Data
fields.description: The frame, as it is (runs to the end of the command)

commands.label: Bind to the router
commands.description: Makes the provider's messages commands for this board, with no header: each message is [key][dir][code][args], its answer comes back on the provider as [status][data] (on ERROR the error record). The binding is the provider's one user; such a command has no peer, so what is kept for a peer (a watch, a subscription, the dead-man) is refused.

commands.label: Unbind from the router
commands.description: Ends the provider's command binding; the provider is free again.
